sections.text: Spaced repetition schedules recall over increasing intervals. Retrieval practice means recalling an answer before checking it.
Recognition identifies a familiar answer. Recall produces the answer without seeing it. Retrieval strengthens memory.
First attempt recall. Next check the answer. Finally schedule the next review. Retrieval strengthens memory.
